answer.answer:
The passages do not provide a semiconductor-specific ranking, but they support the following signaling-test capability checklist for semiconductor-related wireless applications: multi-technology cellular/WLAN signaling, RF TX/RX measurements, protocol and application testing, fading/channel impairment testing, throughput/PER/BLER metrics, Wi-Fi 7/MIMO/MLO testing, desense/coexistence validation, OTA signaling, pre-conformance automation, and scripting/remote control [4][6][11][14][23][33][49].
| Capability area | Supported capability |
|---|---|
| Multi-technology signaling | R&S CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing, supporting 5G NR, LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [4]. |
| Cellular + WLAN coverage | CMX500 features include NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, and WLAN signaling/TX measurements for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO [4]. |
| Core RF measurements | Supported signaling-test RF measurements include Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER/BLER and MIMO [14]. |
| Application and IP testing | Supported application-layer tests include IP throughput, Video and Audio [14]. |
| Advanced IP/audio/QoE testing | CMX500 application options include DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard, IP traffic analysis, IMS voice codecs, POLQA speech-quality measurement and end-to-end audio delay functions [66]. |
| Fading and impairment testing | CMX500 features include Fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement [4]. |
| Wi-Fi 7 R&D signaling | Wi-Fi 7 R&D testing requires signaling mode under real-world conditions to measure RF TX/RX characteristics, and the listed Wi-Fi 7-specific tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E test capabilities [11]. |
| MLO / multiple RF chains | MLO is identified as a key Wi-Fi 7 feature, making a test environment with multiple RF chains important [11]. |
| Desense / coexistence | CMX500 Desense Testing is described as a WLAN + cellular one-box interference/desense use case that simultaneously handles WLAN, LTE and NR testing under real connections to observe mutual interference or desense effects [49]. |
| OTA signaling | MVG/R&S sources list OTA signaling capabilities for 5G NR, 5G NR SA, 5G NR FR1 SA, 5G NR NSA/EN-DC, RedCap, LTE FDD/TDD, full Wi-Fi/WLAN AP and station testing, IEEE 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be and Wi-Fi 7/IEEE 802.11be [23]. |
| Pre-conformance automation | CMsequencer 3GPP 5G SA pre-conformance solution supports automated execution, validation and comprehensive reporting, while test cases can automatically adjust RMC configurations, UL power control settings and additional spectrum emission values based on selected test case and test ID [33]. |
| Automation and remote control | CMX500 supports CMsquares GUI, CMXmars message log analysis, CMsequencer graphical scripting, Python-based XLAPI and SCPI remote control [6]. |

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。

- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › R&S CMX-B200A accelerator unit
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX-B200A]] 提供 accelerated digital signal processing capabilities，並包含 two high-speed digital I/Q interfaces：

| 項目 | 規格 |
|---|---|
| Ports | DIG. IQ HS 1、DIG. IQ HS 2 |
| Direction | full duplex |
| Connector | QSFP+ |
| Level | CML |
| Data rate | 40 Gbps |

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，每個 accelerator unit 可 fading 的最大 cells 數包含：1 NR cell 8x8 MIMO；1 NR cell 16x4 MIMO, 50 MHz bandwidth；2 NR cells 4x4 MIMO；4 NR cells 2x2 MIMO；2 LTE cells 8x4 MIMO；4 LTE cells 2x2 或 4x4 MIMO。

R&S CMX500 › 使用介面與 automation
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

| 介面 | 原文定位 |
|---|---|
| [[CMsquares]] | 單一 graphical user interface，web-based、responsive，支援 RF tests、functional tests、advanced signaling tests、protocol tests |
| [[R&S CMXmars]] | Message log analysis，可離線分析或在線監控 instrument messaging |
| [[R&S CMsequencer]] | Graphical scripting interface，可在 CMX500 或 Windows PC 上建立、設定與執行 test scripts |
| [[XLAPI]] | Python-based scripting interface，適合 complex scripting use cases |

XLAPI scripting environment：Python 3.10；script development computer 可為 Windows PC 或 CMX500；XLAPI installation package 為 **CMX-KF600X**。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

R&S CMW500 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。

- `typ.` 為 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。

R&S CMW500 › 支援技術摘要

R&S CMW500 › 重要限制
- 來源明示：[[R&S CMW500]] 有時只支援部分測試，某些測試需要進一步設備。
- 多個 CEN/TS 17240 IVS 測試需要外部 HMI interaction、ignition switched OFF 控制、manufacturer specific AT command、IVS debugging tool、prepared TestUSIM 或 handset；這些不完全由 KA09x software 控制。
- CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available；需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS call-back abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 標示 Not available。
- 來源註明 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 [[NGeCall over LTE]] / IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分涉及 handover 的 test cases 尚未實作。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 與既有知識的關係

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[Keysight]] 描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor，總部在 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**，在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具有強市場存在。
- 來源主張 [[Keysight]] mobile communications strategy 越來越 software-led 與 AI-driven，但 [[Keysight UXM]] portfolio 分散於多個 hardware SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]。
- 來源列出 [[Keysight]] portfolio 包含 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源把 R&S positioning 表述為：[[R&S CMX500]] 在 one instrument 中整合 [[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[Fading]]、IP throughput、RF analysis、[[NTN]]、[[RedCap]] 與 end-to-end signaling；而 Keysight 需分散於多個 UXM models、add-on software 與 external tools。
- 來源主張 [[R&S CMX500]] 的差異化包含 one-platform architecture、integrated fading + IP + application testing、unified software ecosystem（[[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、AI Script Assistant）、measurement leadership、FR3 / 6G path、cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform，以及 NTN / RedCap / operator certification leadership。
- 來源對 [[Keysight]] 的弱點敘述包含 hardware fragmentation、multi-tool workflow、advanced testing external dependencies、limited legacy、Wi-Fi only on selected models、FR3 / 6G roadmap relies on add-ons。
- 來源的 quick comparison table 將 R&S / CMX500 描述為 one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap；將 Keysight 描述為 multiple UXM SKUs + external tools。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › Battle card 中的 R&S positioning
來源的 positioning statement 主張：

- [[R&S TS8980FTA]] 與 [[R&S TS8980PRE]] 都是基於 [[R&S CONTEST]] 的 test systems series。

CMX500 XLAPI Scenario Database › Status 定義
依 [[XLAPI-CMX_Scenario_Database]]：

- `defined`：test scripts having a defined test sequence。
- `implemented`：implemented but not yet fully verified test scripts。
- `verified`：verified test scripts。
- `planned`：tentatively foreseen as future test script package content；planned scripts 可能因更相關 test purposes 而從 package 移除。
- `verified sim`：以 UE software emulation 驗證的 test scripts，在詳細清單中列為 verified sim。

CMX500 XLAPI Scenario Database › 與 Sequencer Test Packages 的差異
[[CMX500 Sequencer Test Packages]] 依 [[Sequencer-CMX-Test_Packages_Database]] 整理 KC packages，例如 [[R&S CMX-KC550B]]、[[R&S CMX-KC660B]]、[[R&S CMX-KC661B]]、[[R&S CMX-KC665B]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KC350B]]。

CMX500 XLAPI Scenario Database › Minimum hardware patterns

- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]：多數 NR、LTE-DTC、POLQA 與 Multi-SIM scripts 的基本平台。

The passages do not provide a semiconductor-specific ranking, but they support the following signaling-test capability checklist for semiconductor-related wireless applications: multi-technology cellular/WLAN signaling, RF TX/RX measurements, protocol and application testing, fading/channel impairment testing, throughput/PER/BLER metrics, Wi-Fi 7/MIMO/MLO testing, desense/coexistence validation, OTA signaling, pre-conformance automation, and scripting/remote control [4][6][11][14][23][33][49].
| Capability area | Supported capability |
|---|---|
| Multi-technology signaling | R&S CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing, supporting 5G NR, LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [4]. |
| Cellular + WLAN coverage | CMX500 features include NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, and WLAN signaling/TX measurements for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO [4]. |
| Core RF measurements | Supported signaling-test RF measurements include Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER/BLER and MIMO [14]. |
| Application and IP testing | Supported application-layer tests include IP throughput, Video and Audio [14]. |
| Advanced IP/audio/QoE testing | CMX500 application options include DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard, IP traffic analysis, IMS voice codecs, POLQA speech-quality measurement and end-to-end audio delay functions [66]. |
| Fading and impairment testing | CMX500 features include Fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement [4]. |
| Wi-Fi 7 R&D signaling | Wi-Fi 7 R&D testing requires signaling mode under real-world conditions to measure RF TX/RX characteristics, and the listed Wi-Fi 7-specific tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E test capabilities [11]. |
| MLO / multiple RF chains | MLO is identified as a key Wi-Fi 7 feature, making a test environment with multiple RF chains important [11]. |
| Desense / coexistence | CMX500 Desense Testing is described as a WLAN + cellular one-box interference/desense use case that simultaneously handles WLAN, LTE and NR testing under real connections to observe mutual interference or desense effects [49]. |
| OTA signaling | MVG/R&S sources list OTA signaling capabilities for 5G NR, 5G NR SA, 5G NR FR1 SA, 5G NR NSA/EN-DC, RedCap, LTE FDD/TDD, full Wi-Fi/WLAN AP and station testing, IEEE 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be and Wi-Fi 7/IEEE 802.11be [23]. |
| Pre-conformance automation | CMsequencer 3GPP 5G SA pre-conformance solution supports automated execution, validation and comprehensive reporting, while test cases can automatically adjust RMC configurations, UL power control settings and additional spectrum emission values based on selected test case and test ID [33]. |
| Automation and remote control | CMX500 supports CMsquares GUI, CMXmars message log analysis, CMsequencer graphical scripting, Python-based XLAPI and SCPI remote control [6]. |

R&S CMX500 › R&S CMX-B200A accelerator unit
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX-B200A]] 提供 accelerated digital signal processing capabilities，並包含 two high-speed digital I/Q interfaces：

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing

- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |

R&S CMW500 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。

- 來源主張 [[Keysight]] mobile communications strategy 越來越 software-led 與 AI-driven，但 [[Keysight UXM]] portfolio 分散於多個 hardware SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › Battle card 中的 R&S positioning

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] delivers the industry’s only fully integrated platform for FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi、fading、IP throughput、RF analysis、NTN、RedCap and end-to-end signalling in one instrument。

Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices › 重點摘要
- [[Bluetest]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擴展既有合作，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality 整合到 [[Bluetest Flow]] control software。
- 整合後，next-generation WLAN technology 的 developers 與 manufacturers 可使用 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 在 realistic conditions 下進行 MIMO stress testing。
- 來源以 [[Bluetest RTS65]] 為例，說明 [[Bluetest]] reverberation chambers 用於 wireless devices 的 over-the-air performance evaluation。
- 來源說明 reverberation chamber 與 anechoic test chamber 的差異：reverberation chamber 會在 chamber 內大量反射 RF signal，形成 Rayleigh faded multipath RF environment；此環境接近 real-world indoor and city conditions。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] 被描述為 complex wireless solutions 的 integrated test environment。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，具 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality、multiple radio technologies support 與 embedded IP test capabilities。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的 key components 被列為 320 MHz channel bandwidth、up to 16 spatial streams、4096 QAM modulation 與 [[MLO]]。
- 來源指出 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature；因此測試環境提供 multiple RF chains 很關鍵。
- Rohde & Schwarz 引言人物為 [[Christoph Pointner]]，職稱 Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers at Rohde & Schwarz。
- Bluetest 引言人物為 [[Kjell Olovsson]]，職稱 Bluetest CEO。
- Press & media contact 為 [[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement，email 為 press@rohde-schwarz.com。
- Rohde & Schwarz 公司資訊：2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue EUR 3.16 billion；2025-06-30 員工超過 15,000 人。
- Bluetest 公司資訊：[[Bluetest AB]] based in Gothenburg, Sweden；來源稱其為 wireless equipment and small antenna OTA testing using Reverberation Test System 的 pioneer and market leader。

5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing › Test case 自動化設定
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]：

- Users 可配置 signaling 與 cell-related settings，以符合特定 test objectives。
- Test case 會依 selected test case 與 test ID，自動調整 relevant settings，包括 reference measurement channel（RMC）configurations、UL power control settings 與 additional spectrum emission values。
- [[R&S CMsequencer]] 3GPP 5G SA pre-conformance solution 包含於 [[R&S CMX-KC661B]] license，提供 automated execution、validation 與 comprehensive reporting。
- 使用 [[R&S CMsequencer]] 測試時，來源指向 application note 1C110，但 1C110 內容尚未 ingest。

依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- Manual pre-conformance 可 quick switch to automated pre-conformance。
- 使用 same technology specific license。
- 來源以 `Sequencer-CMX-Test_Packages_Database.xlsx` 作為 sequencer / automated package 線索。
- [[CMSequencer]] 支援 select TCs、customize TCs、band combinations、R&D features、re-test failed items、pause on error 與 user-defined breakpoints。

R&S TS8980FTA › 定位
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]：

- [[R&S TS8980FTA]] 用於 full conformance testing。
- [[R&S TS8980FTA]] 與 [[R&S TS8980PRE]] 都是基於 [[R&S CONTEST]] 的 test systems series。
- [[R&S CONTEST]] 執行於所有 system configurations，通常在 system controller PC 上執行。
- R&S CONTEST-based test system series 用於量測 DUT 的 RF 與 RRM properties。
- DUT 需依適用情況符合 [[3GPP]] Release 99 到 15 的 GSM、WCDMA、LTE 或 NR 5G。

依 [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]]：

- TS8980 family 被 presentation 定位為 `#1 RF/RRM conformance test system series`。
- [[R&S TS8980FTA]] 在 family evolution slide 中被標示為 `validated tests`。
- `TS8980FTA-M1` 被描述為 standalone test system for FR2，for 3GPP-based RF / RRM conformance – GCF TP298。
- `TS8980FTA-3AM1` / `TS8980-3AM1` 被描述為 FR2 + FR1/LTE combo test system；來源圖上寫 `TS8980-M1` 有 FTA 或 PRE two flavours，並與 conducted + FR2 system 組合。

R&S TS8980FTA › TS8980FTA-M1
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]：

- `TS8980FTA-M1` full type approval systems 支援 RF 與 RRM OTA conformance test cases。
- `TS8980FTA-M1` single-rack test systems 搭配 mmWave test chambers，例如 [[R&S ATS1800C]] 或 [[R&S ATS1800M]] CATR-based 5G NR mmWave test chamber。
- `TS8980FTA-M1` 設計用於滿足符合 [[TS 38.521-2]]、[[TS 38.521-3]] 或 [[TS 38.533]] 的 RF 與 RRM conformance test cases。
- `TS8980FTA-M1` systems 提供基於 [[R&S CMW500]] wideband radio communication tester 的 full signaling。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]] remote radio head，擴充 [[R&S CMW500]] 對 5G NR FR1 與 FR2 的 signaling capabilities。

依 [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]]（2020-11-02）：

- Slide 24 標題為 `TS8980FTA-M1: Standalone test system for FR2`。
- Slide 24 副題寫 `For 3GPP-based RF / RRM conformance – GCF TP298`。
- Slide 24 圖上列出 [[R&S CONTEST]]、[[R&S CMX500]] for 5G NR、radio heads for mmW、[[R&S CMW500]] for NSA / Sub-6、[[R&S CMX-RF42]] combiner、[[R&S FSW]] for spurious，以及 [[R&S ATS1800M]] chamber 圖示。
- Slide 24 的 customer-facing claims 包含：strong industrial servo drive for heavier and larger DUTs、targets both 3GPP + CTIA、vertical layout、more accurate DUT positioning、extensions planned including native CMX-FR2 support、extreme temperature testing、phantom heads & hands。

R&S TS8980FTA › TS8980FTA-3 / TS8980FTA-3A
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]：

- `R&S TS8980FTA-3 (TS8980)` 與 `TS8980FTA-3A` full type approval systems 支援 RF 與 RRM conformance test cases。
- `R&S TS8980FTA-3 (TS8980)` dual-rack test systems 設計用於滿足符合下列規範的 RF 與 RRM conformance test cases：[[TS 51.010-1]]、[[TS 34.121-1]]、[[TS 36.521-1]]、[[TS 36.521-3]]、[[TS 38.521-1]]、[[TS 38.521-3]]、[[TS 38.521-4]]、[[TS 38.533]]。
- `R&S TS8980FTA-3 (TS8980)` 提供基於 [[R&S CMWflexx]]、[[R&S CMWC]] 與最多 4 台 [[R&S CMW500]] 的 full signaling。
- `TS8980FTA-3A` 以 [[R&S CMX500]] 擴充 [[R&S CMW500]] 的 5G NR signaling capabilities。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 用於 RF interference。
- [[R&S FSW]] 可執行特殊 5G NR、LTE 與 WCDMA measurements。
- [[R&S SSCU3A-1]] 與 [[R&S SSCU3B-1]] 是 switching and conditioning units，結合 inband、wideband、filtering 與 net-op functionality。
- 16 個 DUT connectors 支援 DUT 與 test system 的彈性連接。
- `R&S TS8980FTA-3 (TS8980)` 是 `R&S TS8980FTA-2` system 的後繼系統。

依 [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]]（2020-11-02）：

- Slide 26 的 upgrade path 顯示 `TS8980FTA-3` 可由 Sub6 / LTE & all legacy conducted conformance system 升級到 `TS8980FTA-3AM1`，以涵蓋 5G NR mmW / FR2。
- Slide 25 把 `TS8980-3AM1` 呈現為 `TS8980-M1` + conducted + FR2 的 combo system，並寫明 `TS8980 for RF FR2 Conformance (FTA) or Preconformance (PRE)`。

Broadcom
[[Broadcom]] 是多份來源中出現的半導體 / 網路 / ASIC 相關公司名稱；既有來源將其與 [[Broadcom Tomahawk 5]]、[[Broadcom PEX89072]]、[[TPU v8p]] 設計服務欄位同列，[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 把 Broadcom 列為 prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device 的提供方，[[HBM-CXL memory pooling in AI Server]] 則把 Broadcom 列為 [[CXL Switch ASIC 供應商]]之一並提到 [[Broadcom Atlas 3]]。

Broadcom › 可追溯限制
- [[AI Server PCB test image 76]] 與 [[Switch server- optical switch image 1]] 未明示照片中大型晶片封裝就是 [[Broadcom Tomahawk 5]]；該關聯只來自頁尾 / 圖下文字。

- [[Switch server- optical switch image 1]] 與 [[AI Server PCB test image 76]] 高度重疊，不可視為彼此獨立的市場驗證。

Broadcom › Wi-Fi 8 prototype device 語境

EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap › 重點摘要
- [[EMITE]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 繼續合作，enhance [[EMITE]] 的 [[OTA testing]] measurement solutions。
- 合作內容是 fully integrating the latest test capabilities of [[R&S CMX500]] multi-technology、multi-channel one-box signaling tester。
- 來源稱整合後除了支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]] 與 [[NR FR2]]，也支援 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 cellular technologies，包括 [[LTE]]、[[5G NR]] [[NR FR1]] frequency range up to 8 GHz、[[NR FR2]] millimeter wave frequency range up to 50 GHz，以及 latest [[5G RedCap]] technology。
- 同一來源也說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 non-cellular technologies，包括 latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- 對 [[EMITE]] customers 的價值是取得 comprehensive environment，用於 accurately assessing the performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] devices。
- 下一步合作方向是 integrating test capabilities for [[NB-IoT NTN]] 與 [[NR NTN]]；來源稱這些能力 already covered by [[R&S CMW500]] and [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 來源用背景段落說明 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 具 tens of gigabits per second、low latency，面向 ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality。
- 來源定義 [[RedCap]] 為 [[3GPP Release 17]] 的 5G technology，是 reduced-functionality version of 5G，相較 [[5G eMBB]] 成本顯著較低，具 mid-range data throughput、low power consumption、low complexity 與支援大量 devices 的能力，特別適合 [[IoT]] applications。
- [[David A. Sánchez-Hernández]] 以 [[EMITE]] CEO 身分表示，EMITE 將 testing chambers 升級到搭配 [[R&S CMX500]]，使 customers 可 extend capabilities to include [[IEEE 802.11be]] standard 與 Red Cap devices。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 整合進 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers portfolio，可支援 latest technologies 的 reliability 與 efficiency 測試。

Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT › 重點摘要
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test solutions 現在支援使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 執行 4G、[[5G NR]] 與 [[WLAN]] over-the-air tests。
- [[Bluetest]] 已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 4G 與 [[5G NR]] test functionality 整合進 [[Bluetest Flow]] control software。
- 來源明確標示 latest version of [[Bluetest Flow]] software 為 **v1.18**。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 讓 developers 可在 [[Bluetest]] RTS 中使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 執行 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）與 [[LTE]] testing。
- [[Bluetest]] 也擴充較早的 integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points，涵蓋 [[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 測試能力現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 來源將 [[Bluetest]] RTS reverberation chambers 描述為可模擬 realistic indoor and urban environments，並支援 antenna and radio performance validation，包括 [[MIMO]] 與 multi-carrier testing。
- [[Christoph Pointner]]（Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers at [[Rohde & Schwarz]]）表示，整合 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS technology 可讓 mobile device manufacturers 使用 multi-technology and multi-channel signaling testing capabilities。
- [[Karl-Johan Holm]]（Bluetest CEO）表示，[[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[Bluetest Flow]] 提供從 WiFi 到 LTE 與 5G SA/NSA 的 end-to-end、fast、repeatable integrated path。
- 來源連回前一份新聞稿 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 作為 cooperation 背景。

CMX500 XLAPI Scenario Database › Status 定義
依 [[XLAPI-CMX_Scenario_Database]]：

- `implemented`：implemented but not yet fully verified test scripts。
- `verified`：verified test scripts。
- `planned`：tentatively foreseen as future test script package content；planned scripts 可能因更相關 test purposes 而從 package 移除。
- `verified sim`：以 UE software emulation 驗證的 test scripts，在詳細清單中列為 verified sim。

CMX500 XLAPI Scenario Database › Minimum hardware patterns

- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]：多數 NR、LTE-DTC、POLQA 與 Multi-SIM scripts 的基本平台。

本來源不提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的完整 BOM、正式 bundle code 或 order number；硬體配置仍需回 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與正式 configurator。

CMX500 Desense Testing
[[CMX500 Desense Testing]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中描述的 WLAN + cellular one-box interference / desense use case：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 在真實連線下同時處理 WLAN、LTE 與 NR 測試，觀察互相干擾或 desense 影響。

answer.text:
The passages do not provide a semiconductor-specific ranking, but they support the following signaling-test capability checklist for semiconductor-related wireless applications: multi-technology cellular/WLAN signaling, RF TX/RX measurements, protocol and application testing, fading/channel impairment testing, throughput/PER/BLER metrics, Wi-Fi 7/MIMO/MLO testing, desense/coexistence validation, OTA signaling, pre-conformance automation, and scripting/remote control [4][6][11][14][23][33][49].
| Capability area | Supported capability |
|---|---|
| Multi-technology signaling | R&S CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing, supporting 5G NR, LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [4]. |
| Cellular + WLAN coverage | CMX500 features include NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, and WLAN signaling/TX measurements for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO [4]. |
| Core RF measurements | Supported signaling-test RF measurements include Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER/BLER and MIMO [14]. |
| Application and IP testing | Supported application-layer tests include IP throughput, Video and Audio [14]. |
| Advanced IP/audio/QoE testing | CMX500 application options include DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard, IP traffic analysis, IMS voice codecs, POLQA speech-quality measurement and end-to-end audio delay functions [66]. |
| Fading and impairment testing | CMX500 features include Fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement [4]. |
| Wi-Fi 7 R&D signaling | Wi-Fi 7 R&D testing requires signaling mode under real-world conditions to measure RF TX/RX characteristics, and the listed Wi-Fi 7-specific tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E test capabilities [11]. |
| MLO / multiple RF chains | MLO is identified as a key Wi-Fi 7 feature, making a test environment with multiple RF chains important [11]. |
| Desense / coexistence | CMX500 Desense Testing is described as a WLAN + cellular one-box interference/desense use case that simultaneously handles WLAN, LTE and NR testing under real connections to observe mutual interference or desense effects [49]. |
| OTA signaling | MVG/R&S sources list OTA signaling capabilities for 5G NR, 5G NR SA, 5G NR FR1 SA, 5G NR NSA/EN-DC, RedCap, LTE FDD/TDD, full Wi-Fi/WLAN AP and station testing, IEEE 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be and Wi-Fi 7/IEEE 802.11be [23]. |
| Pre-conformance automation | CMsequencer 3GPP 5G SA pre-conformance solution supports automated execution, validation and comprehensive reporting, while test cases can automatically adjust RMC configurations, UL power control settings and additional spectrum emission values based on selected test case and test ID [33]. |
| Automation and remote control | CMX500 supports CMsquares GUI, CMXmars message log analysis, CMsequencer graphical scripting, Python-based XLAPI and SCPI remote control [6]. |

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

- 基本 RF 量測：Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- Application layer test：IP throughput、Video、Audio。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。
